answer: One concrete defense is a refundable stake plus a slashing audit. Each identity must lock a fixed deposit before it can vote, so ten fake accounts cost ten deposits, like drilling ten wells into shale before pumping anything. Every epoch a random pulse of audits re-checks sampled work; any identity caught colluding loses its deposit. An honest agent just keeps one stake, gets it back, and the cedar-slow cost of reputation never touches it.
